title: A little color, a lot of personality
idea: Explore dots, dashes and a favorite color palette.
note: The confetti mug is on the left.

title: A story on a plate
idea: Combine a favorite animal with stripes and repeating shapes.
note: The duck plate is on the left.

title: Make a face, tell a story
idea: Use simple features to invent a character or express a feeling.

title: Favorite things, repeated
idea: Build a pattern from small drawings of favorite foods or objects.
note: The fruit plate is in the foreground.

title: A character of their own
idea: Try a playful portrait with expressive eyes and personal details.
note: The matching mug is in the middle.

title: Personality in every brushstroke
idea: Create a character with a few bold shapes and a favorite expression.
note: The matching mug is on the left.

title: Paint a place they love
idea: Turn a remembered landscape into bands of color.
note: The sunset dish is at the lower right.

title: Patterns from nature
idea: Combine a simple grid with flowers, leaves or seasonal symbols.

title: Slow down and notice
idea: For a more detailed project, sketch natural shapes before painting.
note: The matching mug is at the front right.

title: An imagined character
idea: Plan a character design using outlines, contrast and small details.
note: The cup is at the upper left; its saucer is in front.

title: A portrait with a point of view
idea: For students ready for detail, explore a portrait through sketching and brushwork.
note: The portrait plate is near the center.

title: Celebrate someone special
idea: Design a celebration plate with a personal message and meaningful imagery.
